name: Alistair Campbell
bio:
Alistair Campbell's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. He initially trained as a mechanical engineer, focusing on precision machining and material science. A chance encounter with a local racing team needing help with engine diagnostics led him to discover a passion for the high-stakes world of competitive racing. Alistair quickly realized his meticulous attention to detail and analytical skills were perfectly suited for quality control.

He's spent the last two decades honing his craft, working his way up through various teams before landing at Team Penske. Alistair's approach is simple: leave no stone unturned. He believes that even the smallest imperfection can be the difference between victory and defeat, and his relentless pursuit of perfection has earned him a reputation as a demanding but highly respected member of the team. His blend of technical expertise and innovative problem-solving sets him apart.

physical.description: Alistair is a man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting every observation.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting the calibration of all measuring instruments before each race.
